mapper.sql: id, bug_id, content, attachments, created_by, create_time
mapper.select: select u.id, u.bug_id, u.content, u.attachments, u.created_by, u.create_time, m.sender_kind from jiedan_bug_update u left join jiedan_bug_reply_meta m on m.update_id = u.id where u.bug_id = #{bugId} order by u.id asc

select u.id, u.bug_id, u.content, u.attachments, u.created_by, u.create_time, m.sender_kind from jiedan_bug_update u left join jiedan_bug_reply_meta m on m.update_id = u.id join jiedan_bug b on b.id = u.bug_id where b.order_id = #{orderId} order by u.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into jiedan_bug_update (bug_id, content, attachments, created_by, create_time) values (#{bugId}, #{content}, #{attachments}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime})
insert into jiedan_bug_reply_meta (update_id, bug_id, sender_kind, sender_id, request_key, payload_hash) values (#{updateId}, #{bugId}, #{senderKind}, #{senderId}, #{key}, #{hash})
mapper.select: select payload_hash from jiedan_bug_reply_meta where bug_id = #{bugId} and sender_id = #{customerId} and request_key = #{key} and sender_kind = 'customer' for update
select exists(select 1 from jiedan_bug_reply_meta where update_id = #{updateId} and bug_id = #{bugId} and sender_kind = 'team')
mapper.insert: insert into jiedan_customer_issue_seen (customer_id, bug_id, update_id) values (#{customerId}, #{bugId}, #{updateId}) on duplicate key update update_id = greatest(update_id, #{updateId})
mapper.update: update jiedan_bug_update set attachments = #{attachments} where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from jiedan_bug_update where bug_id in (select id from jiedan_bug where order_id = #{orderId})
